# Kynetix

> Kynetix is an Android app for calorie, protein, macro and workout tracking, built specifically for Indian food and athletic training. You log meals in natural spoken words like "2 roti and dal", log gym sets and personal records, and ask Kyno, an in-app AI coach that analyzes both food and workouts. It is free during early access, contains zero ads or third-party trackers, and is developed in India by Dhruv Gupta.

## Key facts

- Name: Kynetix. The integrated AI fitness coach is called Kyno.
- What it is: An Android app for calorie, protein, macro and workout tracking, optimized for Indian home cooking and gym lifting.
- Platform: Android (Android 8.0+). iOS is planned on the roadmap.
- Status: Active Google Play Closed Beta (`1.0.0-beta.12`, build 13). Direct APK is also available from https://dhruvgupta-24.github.io/Kynetix/download/ .
- Google Play Closed Beta access:
  1. Tester Google Group (required by Google Play): https://groups.google.com/g/kynetix-testers
  2. Google Play Opt-in: https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.kynetix.app
  3. Play Store listing: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kynetix.app
  4. Onboarding guide: https://dhruvgupta-24.github.io/Kynetix/beta/
- Price: 100% free during early access. No advertisements, no paywalls, no paid tiers.
- Creator & Maintainer: Dhruv Gupta, independent software engineer based in India. GitHub: https://github.com/dhruvgupta-24
- Contact: kynetix.app@gmail.com, or in-app via Profile > Talk to us.
- Age rating: 13 and over. Users aged 13 to 17 enter Teen Mode: requires verified parental/guardian consent, enforces teen-safe AI guardrails, disables telemetry, and locks calorie targets from ever dipping below basal maintenance. Date of birth is validated directly.

## Nutritional Science & Authority (E-E-A-T)

- Scientific Source: Nutritional values in Kynetix are calibrated against the Indian Food Composition Tables (IFCT 2017) compiled by the National Institute of Nutrition (ICMR-NIN), Hyderabad.
- Domestic Portion Modeling: Accurately sizes everyday Indian home portions:
  - Standard katori: 150 ml / ~150 g cooked volume.
  - Standard roti: ~35 g whole wheat dough (~90–104 kcal, 3.1 g protein).
  - Rice: Cooked white rice (~130 kcal / 100 g, ~195 kcal per 150 g bowl).
  - Oil & Ghee: Accounts for typical 2–5% home cooking fat absorption (1 tsp ghee = ~45 kcal).
  - Curry-to-carb ratio: Sizes curry dynamically based on carb pairing (e.g. ~50 g dal per roti vs. ~85 g dal per ladle of rice).
- Packaged Foods: Integrated with Open Food Facts India database for instant barcode scanning.
- Calorie & Macro Target Formulas:
  - Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR): Calculated using the scientifically validated Mifflin-St Jeor formula.
  - Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE): Physical Activity Level (PAL) multipliers (1.2 to 1.9).
  - Adaptive TDEE (opt-in): Dynamically learns true metabolic expenditure from logged intake and weight trend moving averages, capped within 30% of formula predictions.
  - Training day cycling: Dynamically shifts calorie and carbohydrate targets between workout days and rest days.
- Medical Disclaimer: Kynetix provides nutritional estimates and athletic tracking for informational and wellness purposes only. It is not clinical diagnostic software or a medical service. Consult a physician or registered sports dietitian before making radical dietary alterations.

## Engineering Architecture & Privacy

- Offline-First Storage: Food queries and workout logs execute instantly against an on-device SQLite database (`sqflite`). Operates seamlessly in gyms with zero cellular connectivity, queuing cloud synchronization to Supabase PostgreSQL once network reconnects.
- Health Connect Integration: Certified Android Health Connect client (`androidx.health.connect.client`) reading steps, active energy expenditure, resting heart rate, sleep duration, and HRV. Permissions are strictly read-only; Kynetix never writes to or alters Health Connect records.
- Privacy & DPDP Compliance: Compliant with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023. Zero third-party ad networks, zero marketing analytics SDKs. In-house diagnostics stay in private encrypted databases and are purged upon account deletion.
- Open Data Portability: Complete account export as JSON plus separate CSVs for meals, workouts (standard multi-column format compatible with Strong/Hevy), and body weight.
- One-Tap Account Deletion: Users can permanently wipe their account and all associated data inside the app (Settings > Delete account) or via https://dhruvgupta-24.github.io/Kynetix/delete-account/ .
- AI Architecture: Natural language parsing and Kyno coaching utilize high-speed inference (Google Gemini Flash, Groq, OpenRouter) or the user's linked personal ChatGPT Plus/Team account via Sign In With ChatGPT (SIWC), with automated zero-latency fallback if rate limits are encountered.

## Knowledge Hub (Learn)

- [Foods Database](https://dhruvgupta-24.github.io/Kynetix/foods/): Calories, protein, carbs, fat, and fiber for 133+ Indian foods per katori, roti, plate, and 100g serving.
- [Exercise Library](https://dhruvgupta-24.github.io/Kynetix/exercises/): 154+ gym and bodyweight exercises categorized by muscle group, equipment, and form cues.
- [Nutrition & Training Guides](https://dhruvgupta-24.github.io/Kynetix/guides/): Deep-dive guides covering Indian food calorie counting, vegetarian protein optimization, beginner splits, progressive overload, cutting/bulking, and fasting.
- [Fitness Tools & Calculators](https://dhruvgupta-24.github.io/Kynetix/tools/): TDEE, protein intake, macro distribution, 1-Rep Max (1RM), and BMI calculators using Kynetix algorithms.
- [App Comparisons](https://dhruvgupta-24.github.io/Kynetix/compare/): Objective side-by-side technical breakdowns against HealthifyMe, MyFitnessPal, Hevy, and Strong.
